create_ToTensor: create a transform that converts PIL images or arrays to pytorch tensors with configurable dtype and device
build_AutoBatch: build a batch collation transform that stacks tensors, numbers, dicts, tuples, and NamedContext items into batched structures
test_Unbatch: test the reverse batch operator that splits batched tensors, dicts, tuples, and NamedContext back into individual items
refactor_NormalizeRange: refactor the range normalization transform to map input values from one numeric range to another
review_Clamp: review the clamp transform that in-place clamps tensor values to a specified min and max range
